threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look for a quiet spot in Dalston when every café’s crammed with noise. Locals know the best hideouts by heart.
Caught a bus from Brixton to Clapham last night. Two blokes argued over a broken seat, then bonded over how ridiculous the Tube strikes are. Typical night!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a kid selling homemade lemonade at 10 pm next to the kebab shop. That's Neukölln for you—unexpected and vibrant.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a Spätkauf that doubles as an art gallery with local artists' work on the fridge doors. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to time their burrito runs with BART’s inevitable delays; work folks just complain about the wait without a plan.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton last week, bus driver stopped mid-route for a street performer’s solo. Only in SF does the commute pause for art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always ask for paella at local bars. The real deal here is the calçots in season; skip the rice and embrace the onions.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered expressions when they can't find a taxi at 3 AM. Locals just know the night buses run.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app as if it's reliable—everyone knows it's just for decoration in these parts.
Last night on the 196, a group argued over whether Jimi or Amy was the true Brixton legend. They settled on the fish and chips at Etta's instead.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the sound of a street artist's saxophone blended perfectly with the chatter from the Döner stand below my window at midnight.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a Frankfurter at 3 AM in a club still dancing while holding a currywurst in one hand. Multitasking at its finest!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a real local by how they navigate BART delays—no panic, just a calm stroll to the nearest taco truck for a snack.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo hop on the 38 Geary like it was a red carpet. Only in SF do you dress up to ride the bus on a Friday night.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Castell de Gràcia' is a sight. It's just a regular building; locals walk past it every day without a second glance.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they constantly stop to take photos of cada balcó. Locals roll their eyes but secretly appreciate the charm.
